title: Summoning team present the night of the egg
summary: Jake Barber tells of Summoning team present the night of the egg, about c. 2014 at California desert, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I can tell you that that night there was another team present that I know of that uh deals with the summoning component of data collection.

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot, says that around 2014 he flew a mission in the California desert to pick up a large egg-shaped object he believes was not made by humans. He told the podcast host Jesse Michels that another team was there that night, one whose job was to summon such objects as a way of gathering data. If true, it would mean summoning UFOs was part of how secret recovery work was done.
